name: Formula Student UK 2026 — Sim Racing Series
details: Formula IUT made its debut in the Race Engineering Challenge at Formula Student UK 2026, hosted at the Williams F1 HQ. The team secured 9th place out of 72 universities worldwide in the final race and earned strong praise and recognition from industry-leading motorsport judges.

name: Formula Student China 2025
details: Formula IUT travelled to Zhengzhou, China for Formula Student China 2025 (8–12 October) — the team's first on-site international participation with its own car. Highlights: 2nd Best Foreign Team, 8th position in the Business Plan Presentation, and three technical recognition stickers for the team's technical capability and performance.

name: Formula Imperial 2024
details: Formula IUT qualified for the final round of Formula Imperial 2024, securing 7th position overall.

name: Formula Bharat 2023
details: Competing against 50 university teams from different countries, Formula IUT secured 3rd position in the Static Round of Formula Bharat 2023, demonstrating excellence in vehicle design, cost analysis, and business planning.
